**What you are trying to do**, rather than the feature you have in mind for it.

**Why the current config cannot express it.**

**Would it need a server?** QuickPortal deliberately has no backend and no image
of its own, so anything that needs to poll your services from the cluster is out
of scope. Service status indicators are the common case and the README explains
why they are absent.
